about_the_game:
Embark on a thrilling adventure of exploration and survival in Bling: Fortune Memories, a platformer and strategy game set in a mysterious abandoned temple. Play as a young adventurer searching for his lost brother, who vanished while trying to collect the temple’s legendary gems.

Key Features:

  • Strategic exploration: Move on a 2D grid through an environment filled with traps, enemies, and hidden secrets.

  • Invisibility power: Use the Medallion’s power to temporarily become invisible and evade deadly dangers.

  • Puzzles and challenges: Each level introduces new mechanics and obstacles that will test your wits and reflexes.

  • Minimalist art style: A simple, geometric visual style that enhances the strategic gameplay.

  • Collection-based progression: Find and gather gems to unlock new levels and advance the story.

Can you overcome the temple’s challenges and rescue your brother before it’s too late?

short_description: Explore a temple filled with traps and secrets in Bling: Fortune Memories. Use your wits, collect gems, and activate your invisibility ability to overcome challenges while searching for your missing brother. With tactical grid-based movement and a minimalist style, will you achieve fortune?
